decisions.reason: As a core upholstery fabric closely aligned with the firm's long-standing collection and still relevant for residential and contract interiors, it is very likely to stay.
Its flame-retardant performance gives it clear value for hospitality and project business, making it strategically important to retain.
Although newer and therefore somewhat less proven, its versatile use in both upholstery and curtains fits the firm's design-led broad range and supports keeping it on the market.
